LightningComponentBundle.description: Generates a draft Case email reply via the Apologist Agent API and opens Send Email for review. Does not use Messaging conversation APIs.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Title
property.description: Card title shown in the component header.

property.name: cardDescription
property.label: Description
property.default: Generate a draft reply from the Apologist Agent API.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Icon name
property.description: SLDS icon in category:name format (e.g. standard:sparkles, utility:chat).

property.name: iconBackgroundColor
property.label: Icon background color
property.description: CSS color for the card header icon background (e.g. #7137ff).

property.name: buttonColor
property.label: Button color
property.description: CSS color for the Generate Draft Reply button (e.g. #7137ff).

property.name: messageLimit
property.label: Past messages to include
property.description: Number of most recent Case emails to send to the Agent API. Leave blank to include the entire thread.

property.name: namedCredential
property.label: Named Credential
property.description: Named Credential API name for this instance's Agent. Leave blank for Apologist_Agent_Case.
